name: gsmnode
description: gsmnode all-in-one: PocketBase, the API Server and the Web App in one container. Turn a spare Android phone into an SMS/call gateway and drive it from a self-hosted web app or the REST API. On first boot PocketBase upserts its superuser from PB_ADMIN_*, the API Server reconciles the database schema, and — if you fill them in — creates the first app login from GSMNODE_SUPERADMIN_*. Every step is idempotent, so restarts are safe. Only GSMNODE_SUPERADMIN has access to API Server panel. PocketBase admin: http://IP:8070]/_/ API Server + panel: http://IP:8080/ Web App: http://IP:8090/ https://github.com/gsmnode/gsmnode Android Phone Agent: https://github.com/gsmnode/phone-agent/releases Android Phone App: https://github.com/gsmnode/phone-app/releases Unraid Plugin: https://github.com/gsmnode/gsmnode-Unraid Home Assistant Integration: https://github.com/gsmnode/gsmnode-ha Keep both appdata paths on persistent storage — the /data volume holds plugin config with credentials such as IMAP/SMTP logins, so treat it like the database and back it up.

paths.name: Database (pb_data)
paths.description: PocketBase data directory — the database. Must persist across container recreates.

paths.name: App data (/data)
paths.description: API Server state: plugin enable-state and config (plugins.json) plus settings the panel persists. Holds plugin credentials such as IMAP/SMTP logins, so back it up with the database.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Web App (the WebUI link above). Container port 80.

ports.name: PocketBase Port
ports.description: Host port for the PocketBase admin UI / API, reached at /_/. Container port 8070.

ports.name: API Server Port
ports.description: Host port for the API Server and its embedded admin panel (served at /). Container port 8080.

variables.name: PocketBase Admin Email
variables.description: REQUIRED. PocketBase superuser, created/updated on first boot. The API Server uses this to reach the database. Distinct from the app login below.

variables.name: PocketBase Admin Password
variables.description: REQUIRED. Password for the PocketBase superuser. Use a long, unique value.

variables.name: Super-Admin Email
variables.description: First app user, created on boot with role superadmin if no user with this email exists. This is the account you log in to the Web App with. Leave blank to skip and create the first user by hand.

variables.name: Super-Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the app super-admin. Only used when the email above is also set. Use a long, unique value.

variables.name: Super-Admin Name
variables.description: Display name for the app super-admin created above.

variables.name: Bootstrap Schema
variables.description: Reconcile the database schema and create the super-admin on boot (idempotent). Set to false once the database is established to skip it.

variables.name: Message TTL
variables.description: How long a message/call may stay unprocessed before it's marked Failed (Go duration, e.g. 5m, 30s, 1h).

variables.name: CORS Allowed Origins
variables.description: Allowed origin(s) for browsers that call the API Server directly. Match your public Web App URL, e.g. http://tower.local:8090. Comma-separate several.
